subject: Remove redundant count division in genericHgetallCommand (#3573)
reason: The change replaces `setDeferredMapLen(c, replylen, count /= 2); count /= 2;` with `setDeferredMapLen(c, replylen, count / 2);` in genericHgetallCommand. The old compound assignment already passed count/2 to setDeferredMapLen, and the second division only mutated a local variable that is never read again before the function returns (count is dead after this point, as shown at src/t_hash.c:1792-1799).
